title: Education Support
summary: School materials and uniforms help children take part in education.
heroText: Practical support can help open the door to learning.
need: School materials and uniforms are among the practical supports children need to participate in education.
whatWeDo: Provide school bags, notebooks, pens, and uniforms.
Support children's access to school; some children have attended school for the first time with this support.
howItWorks: School materials and uniforms have been provided across the academic years recorded in the foundation's impact data.
